chunks: With this chain of transmission, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from Ḥumayd ibn Ziyād, from al-Ḥasan ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the deceased, and he said: “Turn the inner sides of his feet toward the qiblah.”

key_terms.الْقِبْلَةَ: the direction of the Kaʿbah for ritual orientation
key_terms.بَاطِنِ: the inner side or sole-facing aspect

ai.seo_question: How should a deceased person be positioned toward the qiblah according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal instruction regarding how the deceased is to be positioned. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام directs that the inner sides of the feet be oriented toward the qiblah, indicating the prescribed manner of facing the deceased toward it at death.
